summary: Responsive industrial production tracking web application for a Shipping Container Manufacturing Unit focused on 40ft High Cube Containers with role-based access control (Admin can add/edit, Viewer can only view dashboard), operation-wise daily production database, dashboard, history, dispatch tracking, and operation-wise status. Mobile-friendly with clean industrial UI.
architectural_notes: Mobile-first responsive design for smartphone data entry
Clean industrial dashboard style UI with table layout and summary cards
Operation-specific production tracking with 17 predefined manufacturing operations for 40ft High Cube Containers
Daily_Production_Report table structure: id, date, operation_name, today_production, total_completed, despatched, in_hand
Admin Production Update Panel performs automatic calculation: In Hand = Total Completed - Despatched
Production Dashboard auto-refreshes when new production data is entered
Monthly Production Summary displays monthly target of 100 containers with calculated metrics
Role-based access control: Admin role can create/edit production data, Viewer role has read-only dashboard access
All production data stored securely in internal backend database with authentication required

existing_features.title: Implement admin authentication system using Internet Identity that restricts access to all production features to authenticated administrators only

Create a daily production data entry form that allows administrators to record production metrics including date, container type, quantity produced, shift information, and any relevant production notes
Build a production dashboard that displays summary cards showing total production metrics, recent production entries, and key performance indicators for the current period
Implement date-wise production history view that displays all production records in a sortable, filterable table with search by date range functionality

Create dispatch tracking functionality that allows administrators to record container dispatches with dispatch date, quantity, destination, and tracking reference, and displays all dispatch records in a table

Build operation-wise work-in-hand status view that calculates and displays current inventory by container type, showing produced quantity minus dispatched quantity for each operation or container type

Apply a clean industrial dashboard visual theme throughout the application using neutral industrial color palette (grays, blues, steel tones), clear typography optimized for data readability, structured table layouts for production data, and summary cards with subtle shadows and borders for key metrics

Build a frontend page for Daily Production Report management that displays a form to enter/edit daily production data for each operation with fields for date, operation_name selection, today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand

Create a frontend table view that displays all Daily_Production_Report records in a sortable, filterable table showing all fields (date, operation_name, today_production, total_completed, despatched, in_hand) with edit and delete actions
Add navigation menu item linking to the Daily Production Report page in the main application navigation
Create a new ProductionDashboardPage component at frontend/src/pages/ProductionDashboardPage.tsx that displays a comprehensive live production dashboard
Build a date-wise daily production table component that displays all daily production report records with columns for Operation Name, Today's Production, Total Completed, Despatched, and In Hand
Add three summary cards at the top of the Production Dashboard showing Total Container Produced Today, Total Container Despatched, and Total Work in Hand, calculated from daily production report data
Implement auto-refresh functionality on the Production Dashboard that automatically refetches production data when new production records are created or updated
Add a navigation menu item in the Layout component linking to the new Production Dashboard page at route /production-dashboard
Configure routing in App.tsx to add the new Production Dashboard page at route /production-dashboard, protected by AuthGuard

Add a Monthly Production Summary section to the Production Dashboard page that displays four key metrics: Total Containers Produced This Month, Remaining to Achieve Target (calculated as 100 minus total produced), Production Completion Percentage (calculated as (total produced / 100) * 100), and Daily Average Production (calculated as total produced divided by number of days elapsed in current month)

Style the Monthly Production Summary section using SummaryCard components consistent with the existing dashboard design, displaying the four metrics in a grid layout that follows the industrial theme with appropriate icons for each metric
Add a line chart component to the Production Dashboard page showing Date vs Total Production Output trend, displaying daily total production aggregated from daily production reports over time
Create a bar chart component showing Operation-wise Production Comparison, displaying total production quantities grouped by operation name from daily production reports
Position both charts prominently on the Production Dashboard page below the monthly and daily summary cards but above the detailed production table

Create a new ProductionHistoryPage component at frontend/src/pages/ProductionHistoryPage.tsx that displays a comprehensive production history interface with date range filtering and edit capabilities for daily production report records
Integrate the DailyProductionReportFilter component into the ProductionHistoryPage to allow administrators to filter production data by date range and operation name

Display all daily production report records in the DailyProductionReportTable component on the ProductionHistoryPage, showing date, operation name, today's production, total completed, despatched, and in-hand quantities with sorting capabilities

Enable inline editing of previous daily production report entries in the DailyProductionReportTable on the ProductionHistoryPage, allowing administrators to modify today_production, total_completed, and despatched values with automatic in_hand recalculation
Add a navigation menu item in the Layout component linking to the Production History page at route /production-history
Configure routing in App.tsx to add the new Production History page at route /production-history, protected by AuthGuard
Create a custom React hook 'useGetCallerRole' at frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerRole.ts that fetches the current user's role using the getCallerRole backend function

Update the AuthGuard component at frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx to check caller role and conditionally render components: show full application to admin users, show read-only dashboard access to viewer users, and show access denied to unauthenticated users

Update the Layout component navigation menu at frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx to conditionally display menu items based on user role: show all navigation items to admin users, show only dashboard links to viewer users

Hide or disable all data entry forms and edit/delete buttons on frontend pages for viewer users: disable DailyProductionReportForm, ProductionEntryPage form, DispatchEntryForm, and edit/delete actions in all tables

Create live Production Dashboard page with date-wise daily production table (columns: operation name, today's production, total completed, despatched, in hand) and summary cards showing total containers produced today, total containers despatched, and total work in hand with auto-refresh

Update all backend mutation functions (addProductionRecord, addDispatchRecord, createDailyProductionReport, updateDailyProductionReport, deleteDailyProductionReport) to check that the caller has 'admin' role before allowing the operation, returning an error if the caller has 'viewer' role
